---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea for this project
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Motivation / Use Case
Why is this feature needed? What problem does it solve?
Describe the use case and who would benefit.

## Proposed Solution
How should this feature work? Describe the expected behavior.

## Alternative Solutions
Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## Implementation Ideas
If you have technical ideas for implementation:
- Which provider(s) would this affect?
- Any API changes needed?
- Backward compatibility considerations?
- Configuration options?

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or references:
- Related issues or PRs
- Similar features in other tools
- API documentation links

## Checklist
- [ ] I have searched existing issues for duplicates
- [ ] This feature aligns with RConsoleAI's goals (free, local-free, privacy-first)
- [ ] I'm willing to help implement or test this feature
